text: Hired systems_engineer as startup-systems-engineer: Tech Lead identified a critical bottleneck in backend logic and core game mechanics. startup_senior_dev is currently over-leveraged with foundational work (collision, loops) that prevents them from focusing on high-value feature development like advanced ghost AI/pathfinding. A dedicated systems engineer will offload these foundational requirements.
